name: Nguyen Chich
role: Independent rebel leader in Thanh Hóa who joined Lam Sơn and proposed the strategic pivot to Nghệ An
known_facts: Not an ordinary recruit: he had raised his own revolt and commanded his own army before joining Lê Lợi around 1420
Đại Nam nhất thống chí records that his orders were obeyed across the districts of Đông Sơn, Nông Cống and Ngọc Sơn
Proposed the decisive strategy in late 1424: strike Trà Lân first, take Nghệ An as a footing, then use its manpower and grain to turn north on Đông Quan
Knew the roads of Nghệ An from having travelled them, which is why he could argue the case
The pivot turned six years of stalemate at Lam Sơn into control of the country from Thuận Hóa to Thanh Hóa within a year
Ranked among the leading công thần honoured after victory
interpretation: Early Later-Lê Vietnamese commander dress based on the user reference.
unknowns: No verified contemporary life portrait survives
